dmca.title: DMCA & Disclaimer
dmca.subtitle: Read this before sending a takedown notice — it saves both of us time.
dmca.note1: AniScroll is a personal side project I build because I love anime and I wanted a player that felt right. It is not a business — there are no ads, and there never will be.
dmca.note2: Right now the site is actively maintained and getting regular updates — see the changelog in the navbar for what landed recently. That said, I can't promise it will always be the case. Real life, time, and motivation all have a vote. If updates ever slow down or stop, that's why.
dmca.note3: Thanks for using the site. If you find a bug, use the Report button in the navbar and I'll get the message.
dmca.disclaimer1: AniScroll does not host any video, audio, or manga files. Every stream you watch and every page you read is served from a third-party source — we only link to them, the same way a search engine links to a webpage.
dmca.disclaimer2: We do not control those third-party hosts, their availability, their content moderation, or how long any given link will keep working. If a link is broken or returns problematic content, report it via the in-app form and we'll remove the association from our index.
dmca.process1: We comply with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA). If you are a rights holder and you believe content indexed on AniScroll infringes your rights, send an email with the information listed below. Allow 2 – 5 business days for a response.
dmca.process2: Note: contacting our hosting / DNS / CDN providers will not speed things up and may delay the takedown by routing your request through the wrong queue.
dmca.include1: Your name, postal address, and a working phone number.
dmca.include2: Identification of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed.
dmca.include3: The complete URL(s) on AniScroll where the infringing material is referenced.
dmca.include4: A statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is not authorised, and that the information you provide is accurate.
dmca.include5: A physical or electronic signature of the rights holder or authorised representative.
dmca.emailNotice: An email address for DMCA notices is
dmca.emailRest: . In the meantime, please use the Report button in the navbar with as much detail as you would put in an email and I'll follow up.

sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: The open databases and communities whose data powers AniScroll.
sources.thanks1: AniScroll creates none of this data. The entries, the artwork, the themes, the scores — all of it comes from open projects and the communities that have maintained them, mostly unpaid, for years.
sources.thanks2: This page names them. Some require it; the rest have earned it.
sources.legalNote: All logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners. AniScroll is not affiliated with any of these services.

desc.anilist: The backbone: entries, titles, synopses, cover art, scores, genres, season relations, airing schedule, characters — and your list sync.
desc.fanart: Artwork, logos, banners and backgrounds. Also the fallback for episode thumbnails when no image of the episode exists.
desc.animethemes: Opening and ending themes: song titles, artists, and the video clips playable in the Opening / Ending tab.
desc.mal: The per-episode community scores shown on the Scores tab.
desc.jikan: The open API that makes MyAnimeList data reachable.
desc.tmdb: The wide key art behind the hero banners, the title logos, and the episode thumbnails ani.zip is missing.
desc.anizip: Per-episode titles and stills, keyed straight on the AniList id — nothing to map, nothing to mismatch.
desc.fribb: The cross-database ID map, without which none of these could be matched to each other.
desc.aniskip: Community-sourced timestamps for skipping openings and endings.
desc.animeskip: Opening/ending skip timestamps, as a complement.
desc.tracemoe: Search by image: give it a screenshot and it names the anime, the episode and the second it was taken at.
desc.youtube: The trailers — on the info page, and the one that plays under the cursor on a card.
desc.gtranslate: Translates the synopses and episode titles that only exist in one language.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: AniScroll is a platform where you can watch and stream anime or read manga for free, without any ads or VPNs. Our mission is to provide a convenient and enjoyable experience for anime and manga enthusiasts all around the world.
about.p2: At our site, you will find a vast collection of anime and manga titles from different genres, including action, adventure, comedy, romance, and more. We take pride in our fast and reliable servers, which ensure smooth streaming and reading for all our users.
about.p3: We believe that anime and manga have the power to inspire and entertain people of all ages and backgrounds. Our service is designed to make it easy for fans to access the content they love, whether they are casual viewers or die-hard fans.
about.p4: Thank you for choosing our website as your go-to platform for anime and manga. We hope you enjoy your stay here, and feel free to contact us if you have any feedback or suggestions.
